subject: Retention evidence & exception flow — Onyx Health (audit logs / SSO / BYOK)
messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@onyxhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>; security@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@onyxhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Onyx] Evidence & short-term exception for retention + BYOK integration

Hi Hannah / Redwood security team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Onyx is preparing for a vendor review next month and we ran into a couple of items that need concrete evidence or short-term exceptions to keep our rollout timeline:

- Audit logs: We need an example of full-activity audit exports (tokenized/hash view is fine) covering admin actions and model selection for a 30-day window.
- Data retention: Our lawyers require proof that retention TTLs can be set per-tenant and evidence of deletion workflows.
- BYOK/KMS: We have an HSM-backed KMS requirement; can you confirm attestation docs and whether Redwood supports customer key rotation schedules?
- SSO/SAML: We need SSO metadata ingestion and a proposed failover plan if SSO is down during onboarding.

We attached a one-page priorities doc. Can you confirm what you can provide this week vs. what needs product work / exception approvals?

Sana
Onyx Health — Security
Attachment: Onyx_Security_Priorities.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@onyxhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Onyx] Evidence & short-term exception for retention + BYOK integration

Sana — thanks for the clear list and the priorities PDF. Looping in Neha (security) and Marcus (product) to scope what we can deliver immediately and what requires a short-term exception or roadmap change.

Quick answers up front:
- Audit logs: We can provide an export sample and an evidence pack today showing admin actions + model selection, with redacted PII.
- Data retention: Per-tenant TTLs are on the roadmap; we can offer an exception that enforces a manual delete workflow plus audit annotations for 90 days while we accelerate a retention control.
- BYOK/KMS: We have a BYOK design for Dedicated/Private; for hosted we'll need to validate rotation attestation against your HSM requirements — Neha can propose an evidence checklist.
- SSO: We support SAML SSO; Marcus will propose an onboarding failover pattern (metadata import + test user fallback).

Action: Neha will send an evidence requirements checklist and a recommended temporary control set. Marcus will map the roadmap options and provide an ETA. I'll coordinate legal/procurement for the exception term.

Hannah
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>; Sana Patel <sana@onyxhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Onyx] Evidence & short-term exception for retention + BYOK integration

Hi all — I put together the evidence checklist (attached) and a proposal for a limited exception flow. Highlights:

- Evidence pack (we can deliver within 48 hours):
  * Audit-log sample (admin actions, model selection, timestamps) — redacted identifiers, signed manifest.
  * Retention workflow doc (how TTLs are enforced today, planned per-tenant controls).
  * KMS design summary & attestation template for our BYOK integration (for Dedicated and Private deployments); hosted BYOK requires an MSA amendment.

- Proposed temporary controls (exception window = 90 days):
  * Manual deletion runbook with audit annotation and required two-person review for tenant-admin deletions.
  * Export-of-record delivered to Onyx S3 with server-side encryption (encrypted at rest with Redwood-managed key) until BYOK is onboarded.
  * Weekly status checkpoint with Hannah + Onyx security to confirm progress.

Constraints / notes: hosted BYOK for HSM-backed rotation will trigger procurement and legal review (MSA redline). If Onyx requires host-key never-exportable HSM binds, that will push to Private deployment.

Attachment: evidence_requirements.md

-Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>; Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@onyxhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Onyx] Evidence & short-term exception for retention + BYOK integration

Thanks — a few product-level notes so we align on expectations:

1) Roadmap options & estimates:
   - Audit-stream export: target Q3 sprint to provide a tenant-scoped audit export endpoint (ETA: 8–10 weeks if prioritized).
   - Retention controls: minimal UI + TTL API could be done in 6 weeks as a high priority patch; full per-asset retention + self-service in 12–14 weeks.
   - Hosted BYOK: requires MSA + infra changes; estimate 10–12 weeks to deliver a managed workflow (rotation APIs, attestation). Private deployment is faster for full HSM guarantees.

2) Canary approach:
   - We can do an evidence-only canary for Onyx on the hosted platform: deliver the audit export + manual retention control and operate under the 90-day exception.

3) Ask of Onyx / Sales: confirm if Onyx is willing to accept the 90-day manual-control exception and whether they can provision a temporary S3 bucket for export ingestion.

I’ll add the retention TTL story to the Q3 planning doc and will follow up with an ETA + owned ticket.

-Marcus
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@onyxhealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@onyxhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Onyx] Evidence & short-term exception for retention + BYOK integration — MAP and next steps

Sana / Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround. Recapping the mutual action plan so everyone has owners and dates. Please reply if anything below should change.

Mutual Action Plan (MAP):
- M1 (48h): Redwood to deliver evidence pack (audit export sample, retention workflow doc, KMS attestation template). Owner: Neha.
- M2 (by EOW): Onyx to confirm acceptance of 90-day manual-control exception and provide temporary S3 for exports. Owner: Onyx (Sana).
- M3 (90 days): Redwood operates under exception window, conducts weekly status calls, and delivers retention-ttl patch if prioritized. Owner: Marcus / Product.
- M4 (procurement/legal): Redwood legal to prepare MSA redline for hosted BYOK or propose Private deployment for HSM bind. Owner: Legal / Procurement.

Immediate asks for Onyx: please send S3 bucket details and whether you require keys to be non-exportable from HSM (this determines Private vs Hosted path).

I will schedule a standing 30-min weekly check-in starting Monday to track progress. Marcus — please add the retention TTL JIRA ticket and mark for Q3 planning if Onyx approves. Legal — attached is the initial MSA redline (onyx_msa_redline_v1.docx) for review.

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
